scenes.name: NO RULER
lines: Most physics starts with a ruler: a zero mark, an outside frame, the origin.
大多数物理从一把尺子开始：一个零刻度，一个外面的坐标架，一个原点。
But who handed us that zero? Take the ruler away, and keep only comparisons.
可是，谁把这个零交给了我们？把尺子拿走，只留下比较。
Two moves are left. One carries the step from y to x over onto z.
只剩两个动作。一个：把从 y 到 x 的那一步，原样搬到 z 上。
The other reads how alike two points are: one means identical, zero means fully mismatched.
另一个：读出两点有多像；1 表示同一个点，0 表示完全失配。
Rules: a step from a point to itself does nothing; carrying never changes a reading.
规则：从自己到自己的一步什么也不做；搬运从不改变读数。

scenes.name: FIVE COLUMNS
lines: The unit quaternions obey every rule, read as one plus their dot product, over two.
单位四元数守住全部规则，读数取“一加点积，再除以二”。
Take five: one, minus one, i, j and k. Their table holds ones, halves, and just two zeros.
取五个：1、−1、i、j、k。读数表里是 1、一半，还有仅有的两个 0。
Its determinant is one eighth, not zero, so these readings need five columns. Four never do.
这张表的行列式是八分之一，不是零：这些读数要五栏才写得下，四栏永远不够。
Lean checks: anything obeying these rules, where order matters and small steps link everything, needs at least five.
Lean 内核检验：凡是守这套规则、讲先后、又能一小步一小步连通的结构，都至少要五栏。

scenes.name: FIVE MEANS QUATERNIONS
lines: Now ask for exactly five columns, readings down to zero, and no gaps.
现在要求：恰好五栏，读数能降到零，没有缺口。
Lean checks the answer: it is the unit quaternions, point for point, moves and readings alike.
Lean 内核检验了答案：它就是单位四元数，一点对一点，动作和读数都对得上。
And any point you like can be sent to one. The origin was never out there; we only chose it.
而且你挑哪个点，就能把哪个点送到 1。原点从来不在外面，只是我们选的。

scenes.name: TWO SHADOWS
lines: Physics ignores an overall phase, so slide one point around its phase circle.
物理不理会整体相位，那就让一个点沿着相位圆滑动。
Read it twice, a quarter turn apart, square both readings, and add them.
读两次，相隔四分之一圈，两个读数各自平方，再相加。
Like a clock hand seen by two shadows: they trade as it turns, but the sum stays 0.36.
像隔着两道影子看一根钟表指针：指针转，两道影子此消彼长，平方和始终是 0.36。
Lean checks that the sum ignores the phase and equals the Born weight of two spinors.
Lean 内核检验：这个和不理会相位，并且等于两个旋量的玻恩权重。

scenes.name: SAME READING, SAME PAIR
lines: On a perfect ball no spot is special: two pins at one distance look like any other two.
在完美的球上，没有哪一处特殊：隔着同样距离的两枚图钉，和任何另一对看起来都一样。
These two pairs both read 0.8, so their quotients share a real part, 0.6.
这两对点的读数都是 0.8，所以它们的商实部相同：0.6。
What is left is an arrow of length 0.8; one turn lays it on the other.
剩下的是一支长 0.8 的箭头；转一下，就叠到另一支上。
Lean checks every pair: equal readings mean one multiplication on each side carries one pair onto the other.
Lean 内核检验：对任意两对点，读数相同，就有左右各乘一次，把一对送到另一对。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: Drop the no-gaps rule, and the rational quaternions pass every other test, yet leave holes everywhere.
去掉“没有缺口”这一条，有理四元数能通过其余每一关，却处处留洞。
The rules, fewest columns included, are our model. Calling the Born weight a probability is a reading, not a proof.
这套规则，连同“栏数最少”，是我们的模型；把玻恩权重叫作概率，是一种读法，不是证明。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter thirty-nine.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第三十九章
